digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent clone management
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume does not refresh on redeploy because the generated entrypoint only clones when .git is absent, preserving divergent history across redeployments.

The entrypoint invokes reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh outside the PAT block, requiring convergence to run even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, but the script currently does not fetch, classify ancestry, or reset divergent clones.

Changes to infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh cannot self-deploy because the script is omitted from autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS, blocking the deploy decision and rsync delivery of scripts-only changes.

Convergence must use explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets to advance the exact remote-tracking ref read by the classifier, fail gracefully when credentials are absent or origin is unreachable, and preserve the local tip to avoid aborting already-cast votes.

Pre-epoch local clones whose pre-fetch tip is an ancestor of a readable prior remote tip should adopt the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when no local-only commits exist, otherwise preserve the exact local tip and require manual intervention.
